# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P38](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0038)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c4 P33](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0033), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Philippa is a very pretty girl with a crooked mouth that flashes into a bewitching smile revealing white teeth. She has a nose in the Gordon pattern, though she worries it might develop her mother's Byrne tendencies as she grows older. After having children, she notes that she has become fearfully thin.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P38](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0038), [v3 c4 P39](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0039), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_

## Personality

Philippa is cheerful, loyal, and free from snobbishness, forming fast friendships and taking great delight in social life. Though she appears frivolous, fickle, and indecisive on the surface, she acknowledges her own faults and possesses a genuine heart of gold. She suffers from chronic indecision, particularly regarding suitors, yet shows strong determination when holding fast to the man she truly loves.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 c4 P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 c19 P22](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0022), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c35 P12](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0012)_

## Goals

- To be chummy with and loved by Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant  <sub>[v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005)</sub>
- To marry the Rev. Jo Blake despite her mother's objections  <sub>[v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)</sub>

## History

Philippa meets Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant in an old graveyard during her early days at Redmond College, instantly taking a liking to them and drawing them into her exclusive social circle. During her first year, she struggles constantly to choose between two home suitors, Alec and Alonzo, while enjoying college life and class rivalry. For their second year, she moves into Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue with Anne, Priscilla, and Stella, helping to set up their household. She falls deeply in love with Jonas (Jo) Blake, a serious minister, and holds firm against her mother's disapproval until her family yields and accepts him. After graduating from Redmond, she marries Jo in Bolingbroke with Anne serving as her bridesmaid. Later, she has children with Jo and visits Anne at Green Gables the day before Anne's wedding to Gilbert Blythe, sending a handmade baby garment to Anne during her time in Four Winds.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c4 P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c7 P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000), [v3 c7 P51](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0051), [v3 c7 P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 c10 P36](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0036), [v3 c10 P54](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0054), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c25 P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044), [v4 c17 P15](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of a wealthy, well-known man from an old 'Bluenose' family in Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- Raised in the family homestead, Mount Holly, in Bolingbroke  <sub>[v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)</sub>
- Her mother belongs to the Byrne family and possesses a prominent Byrne nose  <sub>[v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056)</sub>
- Her paternal grandfather was a minister  <sub>[v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)</sub>
